feedback_driven.quote: Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks

persists_across_tasks.quote: Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks, and the skill is then used on new tasks of the same kind.

data.why_zh: 摘要研究自我演化技能在任务间改写与复用，属于技能文件层演化。
